sql: /* Query 12: filter6_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT team.team_name, city.area, player.position, manager.own_year FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE (player.mvp_awards <= 1 AND team.championship <= 1) OR (manager.nationality = 'Taiwanese-Canadian' AND player.mvp_awards < 0)

team_name.description: team_name is the full name of the team (e.g. Los Angeles Lakers).

area.description: area is the area of the city in square kilometers (e.g. 89.64).

position.description: player's primary position on the team; choose one from ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'].

own_year.description: own_year is year the owner have this NBA team (e.g. 2010).
